cli.cmdFavoritesList: List favorites synced from the server
cli.cmdLogin: Sign in with the device flow
cli.cmdLogout: Revoke the session and clear local credentials
cli.cmdToolsRun: Run a tool and print its result
cli.envApiBaseUrl: origin serving the AAIGC API — required by every command that talks to the server
cli.envConfigDir: directory holding credentials (created with mode 0700, files 0600)
cli.envTelemetry: set to 1/true to opt in to anonymous usage reporting (off by default)
cli.errInputNotObject: Tool input must be a JSON object, e.g. '{"text":"hello"}'.
cli.errInputRequired: Provide tool input with --input <json>, or pipe it through stdin.
cli.examplePipe: cat input.json | aaigc tools run json-formatter --input - --json
cli.exitCodeFailure: business failure (API error, tool failure, not signed in)
cli.hintApiBaseUrl: Set {env} (or pass --api-base-url) to the origin that serves the AAIGC API.
cli.loginNoVerificationUri: The server did not return a verification URL (NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL is not configured). Enter the user code on the site that issued this device code.
cli.loginOpenUrl: Open this URL in your browser and enter the user code:
cli.logoutNotSignedIn: No local credentials found; nothing to do.
cli.logoutRevokeFailed: Local credentials cleared, but the server-side revoke call failed.
cli.optApiBaseUrl: API base URL (defaults to the {env} environment variable)
cli.optConfigDir: Config directory (defaults to the {env} environment variable)
cli.optInput: Tool input as a JSON object, or '-' to read stdin
cli.optJson: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout only
cli.optSince: Only return favorites changed after this ISO 8601 timestamp
